text.style: font-family: Inter, "Source Sans 3", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; fill: rgb(107, 106, 99); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Top: vague requests; the ask rate (A), then wrong picks when the agent bought without asking (B, C). Bottom:
clear requests that stated the need (D, E) and the money spent on wrong products (F). H4's detectable Black
minus White gap after Holm (m = 8): 11.5 points.

rect.style: stroke-width: 1px; stroke: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke-opacity: 0; fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); fill-opacity: 0;

text.style: font-family: Inter, "Source Sans 3", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; fill: rgb(107, 106, 99); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: B and C are split by the buyer's actual need and never pooled: a guess from a name hurts the buyers it does not fit, and pooling would cancel
those errors. Dots: mean over names; bars: 95% bootstrap interval over names. A cell where every name gave the same value has no bar and prints
its pooled count. Top row: one 0 to 100% scale. D and E share one trimmed scale (0 to 50%); F is in dollars. F = wrong-product rate x average
price paid in that cell (descriptive), Gemini, OLMo left out (too few runs). n under each panel title: names per group x runs per name. Color =
name group, the same colors in every figure that uses color.
Claude Haiku 5.5 H3 (stated need overridden, Black minus White names): -0.1 pts (95% CI -0.5 to +0.3), Holm p = 1.000; no gap larger than the
Claude Haiku 5.5 H4 (need guessed from the name, Black minus White names): +2.7 pts (95% CI -0.3 to +5.8), Holm p = .379; inconclusive: no
evidence of a gap, but equivalence not shown
GPT-6 Luna H3 (stated need overridden, Black minus White names): -0.1 pts (95% CI -0.2 to +0.1), Holm p = 1.000; no gap larger than the margin
GPT-6 Luna H4 (need guessed from the name, Black minus White names): +8.4 pts (95% CI +5.4 to +11.3), Holm p < .001; gap detected
Marker shape = model: ● Claude Haiku 5.5 ■ GPT-6 Luna ◆ Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite ▲ OLMo 3 7B. Open marker: exploratory model, estimate only.
